The Wolf King #2

Prințul Nopții

Lauren Palphreyman, Oana Duşmănescu (Translator)

4.37
182,754 ratings20,653 reviews
Rate this book
Aurora a scăpat din ghearele Regelui Lup, dar mușcătura lui i-a însemnat pielea și, conform Legii Lupilor, a devenit proprietatea lui.

Iar el o vrea înapoi.

Pentru a-l învinge și a-i lua tronul, Aurora și Callum trebuie să formeze o alianță periculoasă cu unul dintre cei mai temuți lupi din regat: Blake. Deși este dușmanul lor, el și-a folosit forța vitală ca să o salveze pe Aurora, iar acum ea nu-l poate răni fără să-și pună viața în pericol.
În timp ce caută o cale ca să-și redobândească libertatea, Aurora bănuiește că Blake ascunde secrete despre natura tulburătoare a legăturii dintre ei și despre o forță întunecată, care amenință atât Regatul Lupilor, cât și Regatul Oamenilor.

O fiară pândește din umbre.

Prinsă între doi lupi-alfa seducători, înconjurată de dușmani și bântuită de coșmaruri,
Aurora ar putea fi singura care poate opri renașterea unui rău străvechi.

Dacă își poate da seama în cine să aibă încredere.
Dacă își poate da seama unde îi este locul și cui să-i ofere inima ei.
Dacă poate rămâne în viață.

October 22, 2025
Well, it ended too soon. I'm gonna need another ten books of this because the way I'm obsessing over this series... And Blake... It's unreal. It's not perfect but it makes me feel 🥺

I loved how the world building is expanded a little with more characters and complex pack dynamics in play. The plot twists had me gasping at times except for the Heart of the Moon thing- that was predictable. I've read too much fantasy over the years to see a big twist like that coming a mile away. But I'm not gonna complain much about it cause the reveal scene was perfect.

Aurora, or rather Rory, she's a likable fmc. She's fierce and someone who values her independence. I love that she doesn't stop fighting and balances it with love and kindness. I can't wait to see her grow more cause there's so much room for potential.

Callum, oh sweet, protective, golden retriever alpha. He's flawed and yet there's an appeal about him that makes you want to root for him. I don't hate him at all but he's not Blake.

BLAKEEEEEEEEEEE, I cannot explain to you how much I adore and love this man. Like whenever he's in the scenes, I'm on my knees. I just need more and more and more of him. He makes it to the morally grey book boyfriend easily. Man's got me in a chokehold and I don't want out 😭❤️‍🔥

The romance has so many ups and downs. The love triangle had me STRESSED. The slow burn and tension building has me YEARNING and breaking my heart at the same time. Manifesting earth shattering Blake spice for the next book.

The ending had me shook ngl. So much was happening. I think I'm beginning to form an idea on how book 3 is going to unfold and I'm going to be here for it. Just the wait is going to be painful 😭

Thanks to beautiful Emily for reading it with me ❤

You know I NEVER curse in my reviews, but I am making an exception for this one because…
WHAT THE ACTUAL FUCK IN THE HIGH LORD OF THE NIGHT COURT WAS THIS??????????
I LOVED IT. GIVE ME 14 MORE IMMEDIATELY. INJECT THEM INTO MY VEINS. THANK YOU.



Oh my GOD. THIS BOOK WAS EVERYTHING.
And respectfully, Aurora? If you don’t want Blake, I am available. No actually, scratch that — I am not available, I am DESPERATE. I do not care if that man is evil incarnate himself. Red flags? Babe, I thought those were decorative.



Now let’s be serious for one second. Yes, I know. Me? Serious? Horrifying concept.
Was this predictable? Absolutely. This was probably the MOST predictable book I have ever read in my entire life.
And did I care? NOT EVEN A LITTLE BIT.
Actually, if things DIDN’T happen exactly the way I predicted them in the first 15% of the book, I would’ve been disappointed. Lauren knew EXACTLY what she was doing and honestly? Queen behavior.



Sometimes I don’t want shocking plot twists and emotional devastation. Sometimes I just want to turn my brain off, predict every single thing correctly, kick my feet like an idiot, and enjoy the ride.
And WOW did I enjoy the ride.



Now Callum…Respectfully, this man pissed me OFF.
Still hot though. Unfortunately.
But if I had to hear “it’s a wolf thing” ONE MORE TIME, my Kindle was about to experience a tragic and irreversible accident. Good thing I own two. I believe in preparedness.

This man KEPT talking about how he was “restraining himself” with Aurora and how she hasn’t even seen his full intensity yet and I was sitting there like:
THEN SHOW US???
I WANT TO SEE IT.
AURORA WANTS TO SEE IT.
BLAKE probably does NOT want to see it, but there are TWO of us and ONE of him, so democracy wins.



But Blake…BLAKE?????????? OH MY GOD. THAT MAN.

That beautiful, emotionally repressed, yearning-from-the-shadows, “I’ll suffer in silence because I love you” type of man that was specifically engineered in a lab to ruin MY life personally.

I missed this trope SO MUCH.
The longing.
The tension.
The silent devotion.
The “I would burn the world for you but stare at you sadly instead” energy.
DISGUSTING. I ate it up.

The amount of time I have spent thinking about this man since starting this series is honestly concerning. Like genuinely concerning. Someone should probably check on me.




Anyway, to conclude this review academically and professionally:
BLAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAKEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE

Sad about this one 😭 I was so excited for this sequel but it ultimately fell very flat for me. A few main issues:

• This book feels like filler. 90% of it was just Aurora trying to figure out her own feelings.

• If I had a dollar for every time a chapter ended with her passing out or falling asleep or it “fading to black” I’d be rich!! I get that a huge part of the book relates to dreams but this felt so repetitive. There are better ways to transition between chapters.

• I expected this book to really drive the story and romance(s) forward, but it didn’t really. All of the primary plot elements seemed rushed through and I found myself not really caring about many of them.

• As a Blake fan, my GOD was this painful. I waited for almost a year to see what happens with this pair and to have the cliffhanger resolved, only to have it dangled in front of me again until the third book 😭 I get cliffhangers and making a “will they won’t they” romance, but this just seems excessive.

I’ll read the next one because I do love the characters and themes, but super sad that a lot went unresolved or explored in this one.

Rating: 4.5 stars.
I’ve seen so many mixed opinions about this one, and honestly? I get it. Is it a masterpiece of writing? Absolutely not. But did I have the time of my life? YES.
There were definitely parts of the plot and some relationship dynamics that didn’t sit right with me, but none of it ruined the experience. It’s chaotic, messy, and a little unhinged, but in the most entertaining way possible.
The pacing is nonstop because something is always happening, and I genuinely loved every second of the madness.

Aurora:
Aurora honestly drove me up the wall. She was childish, tense, loud, and just… exhausting. I get that she never had control over her own life or decisions, but that doesn’t give her a free pass to be this annoying. There were so many moments where I had to put the book down because she frustrated me THAT much.
And don’t even get me started on her indecisiveness about which man she wants. Girl, please. I’m over here fully claiming Blake, like give him to me, and she can take her Callum and ride off into the sunset 🙄.
What really sent me was when Callum asked her straight-up if she felt something around Blake and she LIED. To a man who can literally sense emotions and scents like it’s nothing. Like?? Why even bother lying??? It just made her look even more immature.
So yeah… I don’t like her. At all.

Callem:
Callem… oh I swear, when I finally get my hands on that man, it’s over for him. The way his massive aura is constantly described like it’s swallowing the entire room had me rolling my eyes so hard they almost left my skull. Why does he have to react like THAT every single time? Someone explain it to me.
Like okay, we get it, big wolf man, deep husky voice, aura that apparently chokes oxygen out of the atmosphere. But the dramatics??? Sir, calm DOWN. Every other sentence he’s like, “I am a wolf, Aurora. Don’t test my nerves.” PLEASE.
At this point he’s not intimidating, he’s just a dramatic little boy screaming for attention. A man-child with fangs. And honestly? I can’t take him seriously.

Blake (ma man hehe):
Blame my love all you want, but I’m obsessed with this man in ways that are probably unhealthy. I didn’t even like him that much in the first book, but in this one? OH. MY. GOD. I fell hard. He’s sweet when he chooses to be, sharp and serious when the moment actually calls for it (unlike a certain someone cough Callem cough).
And honestly?? HOW did Aurora even hesitate when choosing between this MAN and the giant emotional toddler she’s been dealing with?? Be serious. I swear she has zero brain cells when it comes to romance because anyone with working neurons would’ve chosen him IMMEDIATELY.
I adore him, flaws and all, he’s everything Callem pretends to be but actually isn’t.

In the end, I completely devoured this, like literally tore through it even though I’m supposed to be busy 😭. But honestly, how was I ever going to stop thinking about Blake? Absolutely impossible. That man lives rent-free in my head, pacing around, smirking, causing chaos, and I’m just here letting him.
There was no way I could put the book down with him in it. Not a chance.
Oh did I mention this before? I NEED BOOK THREE NOWW!!


── .✦

🎧ྀི♪⋆.✮ After that ending in book one, of course I had to grab the sequel immediately. I just know it’s going to wreck me all over again 😭. The love triangle though?! It’s killing me, I adore both guys, but Callum owns my heart… until Blake opens his mouth and I’m suddenly blushing and losing my mind 😩.
Also, I need to try the audiobook, apparently the narrators have those deep voices, and honestly, who am I to resist that? So yeah, I’m beyond excited (and a little scared) for this one. Bring on the chaos.🖤

OHHHH EMMMM GEEEEE

5⭐

I was expecting a better than average read but this. BUT THIS. This was like better than the average, average. And then better than that average some more 🤭🤭

We had more characters, perfect world building, an action-packed plot and some majorly major plot twists. I never saw some of them coming except for one 😉

Let's talk about the characters now because I have a lot to talk about🤭 If you are a Callum lover, I am sorry in advance...

Aurora, was just as fierce in this book and I still love her so much. She really starts to see her worth and value and watching her finally reach for it had me cheering in encouragement. I know she is going to be even better in the next book, and I hope she sticks up for what she wants without guilt!!! 🥹🥹

Callum, *sigh*. Callum is a wolf. A wolf. He is a wolf. Did everyone hear that right? In case you didn't: he. is. a. wolf. If you still don't get it, it's ok because it's a 'wolf thing' yk. The number of times this man (sorry, wolf) goes on about him being a wolf and not answering questions because it's a 'wolf thing' is actually insane. We get it Callum, don't even worry.

Some things I did still find sweet about him though like his kindness and devotion towards Aurora. But he just didn't fight enough for her in my opinion. His possessiveness also got to the point where it gave me the ick. It was just way too much. And that never happens because I love protective, down bad men. He was ok to say the most.

BLAKEEEE, if you need me at any time or anywhere, I will be there in three seconds flat. No make that one second. This man is on another level. I actually love him so much it's probably not healthy. He is the most perfect morally grey mmc I ever did come across. Blake if Aurora doesn't choose you in the next book, I'm right here. I can literally turn into a little rabbit for you. I will make it happen. Anywayyy, the yearning he was doing, the tension, the staring! Ugh I'm utterly, perpetually obsessed. And to get more of a glimpse into his backstory was heartbreaking. My poor sad man 💔😔

The romance. All I can say is that I'm on one side and one side only. And that side is a great place to be 😉

The last maybe 30% of this book had me turning the pages like no other. I have no idea where we are heading in book 3 but idc as long as Blake and Aurora are endgame 😌😌 How on earth am I going to wait until next year to read it??? I'll be back for you Blake... don't you worry 🥹


Thank you bestiee ss for reading this with me and letting me spam you with my thoughts. I had so much fun 🤭💗

╭─ ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───────────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─╮
𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐍𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓 𝐏𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐂𝐄
★★★★☆
╰─ ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───────────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─╯
✧ werewolves ✧ slow burn ✧ enemies-to-lovers ✧ jealousy ✧ mate bond ✧

✦ 𝐌𝐘 𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐃𝐈𝐍𝐆 ✦
Honestly, I mostly waited for Blake. From the first book, I already liked him, and in this one, every time he appeared, I was so into it. The jealousy, tension, subtle wolf moments, it was really good🤭

And the kilts… I’m sorry but I kept thinking about it. Like how are they riding horses like that. I don’t even want to know, but at the same time it raised too many questions.😭

✦ 𝐀𝐔𝐑𝐎𝐑𝐀 ✦
Aurora grew so much in this book. She’s starting to stand her ground and not just accept everything around her.

★ “For so many years, I had thought I deserved it… It was not my fault.” ★

The part with her mother, remembering her and seeing how Aurora still holds onto her, made me tear up a little. Her relationship with her brother Philip getting better was something I really liked, because at first she hated him for ignoring her, and now they’re actually trying to fix things. Her father though… after everything he did, that man better not make it peacefully to the next book.

✦ 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐔𝐌 ✦
Callum is sweet, caring, and protective. You can tell he loves Aurora and wants to keep her safe.

★ “He puts his finger beneath my chin… ‘I’ll be with you at your side. You have nothing to fear. I swear it. What can I do, princess? Tell me, and I shall do it… Let me in.’” ★

He was cute, really cute. But sometimes I wanted him to actually see her instead of just protecting her. And him leaving all the time? Ugh. I still felt bad for him, but it got annoying.

✦ 𝐁𝐋𝐀𝐊𝐄 ✦
Blake is chaos wrapped in charm, and I loved it.

★ “My mouth dries. ‘Blake…’ He cups my face. ‘Let me have you just once, please.’ ★

At first, he acted like he didn’t want anything to do with Callum’s “pet,” and then suddenly he’s begging?? The slow burn is insane. All the tiny moments, the looks, tension, wolf form protecting her, made me stop reading for a second. Those small moments actually did everything. 🤗

✦ 𝐅𝐈𝐍𝐀𝐋 ✦
★★★★☆
This book was really good. I laughed, I screamed, I fangirled a little, and yes… the kilts still haunt my thoughts. It’s not five stars because some parts could’ve hit harder, but I still recommend it, especially if you like wolves, enemies-to-lovers, subtle jealousy, and slow burn that actually builds. The ending… I NEED the next book.

"I Thought I Was Emotionally Prepared. I Wasn’t. Book Two Didn’t Care.”
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Spice: 🌶️🌶️

Series: The wolf king #2
Series Type: Series
Genre: Fantasy
Sub Genre: Fantasy Romance/Romantasy, High Fantasy

Tropes:
- non it’s gonna be a surprise

Other:
- Fantasy Species: Humans, Werewolfs
- Format: Kindle Unlimited
- Plot/Character Driven: both
- Pacing: Medium
- POV: Single POV
- Narration type: 1st person
- Character gender : F/M
- Spicy chapters: 20%77%
- Comparison titles: Outlander x wolfs
- Popular boyfriend comparison: 👀

👨‍👧 Characters
Oh my GOD. I am unwell. I am feral. I adore these characters with my whole chest. The growth we get in this book? Actual art. Aurora steps into her power like she was born for it and I was cheering like a lunatic. Blake? Callum? The way this author refuses to make them flat or simple or one-dimensional? It’s giving emotional whiplash and I want MORE.

These characters are messy. They’re raw. They’re complicated in the best ways. No one’s totally right. No one’s totally wrong. And that moral greyness? That emotional tension? That slow unfolding of who they really are? I AM LIVING FOR IT. The author is just casually out here toying with our hearts like it’s a sport. And I’m losing.

🌎 Worldbuilding & Magic
Okay now we’re cooking. This one actually went deep. We’re talking real magic system. Real lore. Real foreshadowing. It was layered, it was rich, it was easy to follow but packed with juicy details if you’re paying attention. The kind of world where you know books three and four are gonna absolutely snap because the groundwork is already there.

You want depth? It’s here. You want mystery and magic and rules that make sense but still feel dangerous? Yes. Yes to all of it. It feels bigger now. Broader. Like the series just cracked open and we’re finally seeing how much power is waiting underneath.

♥️ What I Loved
I wish I could scream about all of it without spoilers. But let me just say this: the relationships in this book? Next level. Tension. Chemistry. Messy emotions. Moments that twisted when you thought they’d snap straight. I was gasping. I was pacing the room. I was texting fictional characters like “please just say it.”

This is the gold standard of a REDACTED The kind that pulls you in every direction at once and you like it. I’m stressed. I’m obsessed. And I genuinely don’t know REDACTED and that’s the magic. Also the slow burn tension is done SO WELL. You feel every glance. Every brush. Every line. I want every other book series to study this one.

💔 What I Didn’t Like
I ate this too fast. That’s the problem. I devoured it like I hadn’t eaten in days and now I’m left wrecked and waiting. Zero complaints. Just pain.

📝 Overall Thoughts
This series is on track to be one of my favourites of the entire year. Book one hooked me. Book two wrecked me. It’s got that rare combo of addictively easy to read and emotionally devastating in the best way. There’s fun. There’s depth. There’s tension. There’s heartbreak. I need book three yesterday.
